  "title": "Channels Sales Executive",
  "description": "Cloud Energy Photoelectric Ltd is a Nigerian-based Solar Energy Company that is focused on the conservation of energy and delivering its immediate needs. These conservation techniques involve utilizing Inverter Systems, Solar Energy, and the use of LED Energy-saving Lighting for the most efficient conservation of energy. At Cloud Energy, we offer exceptional after-sales support with dedicated Engineers and Client Service representatives while providing alternative energy solutions to homes, organizations, schools, industries, and more nationwide.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Channels Sales Executive

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description


	We are a reputable OEM offering a diversified product and services lineup within the renewable energy industry and continuously evolving to meet the changing demands in the market.
	We are currently seeking a Channel Sales Executive to join our Lagos and Port Harcourt team. This role is ideal for a proactive, self-motivated individual with a strong interest in solar solutions.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for driving sales through dealer channels such as partners, wholesalers, distributors, and agents and ensure they are always stocked with our SKUs and continuously increase their volumes while sourcing for more.


Key Responsibilities


	Conduct market research to identify selling opportunities and understand customer needs.
	Develop and sustain solid relationships with existing distributors that bring in the most income for the company.
	Revive relationships with old customers and boost their sales and patronage
	Prospect and secure new Distributors and sales opportunities through cold calling, networking, and other channels.
	Set up meetings with potential clients to understand their needs and concerns.
	Prepare sales contracts and submit orders for processing ensuring customers receive requested products and services in a timely fashion.
	Follow up on complaints and queries on behalf of distributors.
	Conduct site surveys and pre-installation site preparations.
	Prepare quotations and estimates for proposed solutions.
	Deliver effective presentations on products and services to clients.
	Prepare frequent reviews and sales forecasts.
	Ensure availability of stock for sales based on demand forecasts.
	Ensure daily, weekly and monthly report of your territory and partners.
	Follow up with customers to make sure that they are satisfied with their purchases and to answer any questions or concerns they might have
	Building and maintaining a CRM database.
	Meeting monthly and quarterly sales targets.
	Participating in sales team meetings remotely and physically.
	Represent the company at exhibitions and conferences.


Qualifications


	HND / B.Sc in Electrical and/or Electronics Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, or any similar background.
	Minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience in this role.
	Basic experience or understanding of solar products and solutions.
	Must have a prior experience managing Channels Sales preferably in the renewable energy industry.
	Must have an existing database of re-sellers in the renewable energy business.
	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and influence decision-makers.


Our Offerings


	Attractive salary packages will be offered based on skills and experience.
	Medical Insurance (HMO).
	Pension plan with employer contributions.
	We offer in-house training, both classroom-based and on-the-job, to develop your skills and qualifications.
	Logistics Allowance.
	Call &amp; Data Allowance.
	Weekend Incentives.
	Quarterly Commission on Individual targets met.
	Quarterly Commission on Group targets met.
	Quarterly Commission on Team Leads targets met.


Method of Application&nbsp;

Backend Engineer (Elixir) Job at Helium Health




        
    

        
        Helium Health, is a full-service Healthtech company on a journey to digitize healthcare across Africa. We have been doing this since 2016, and our pioneering approach has helped to transform healthcare delivery systems across Sub-Saharan Africa and the GCC, creating an alternative vision for patients and providers, whilst facilitating hundreds of thousands of high-quality patient experiences every month.
     

            
    



We are very good at creating for the market we live in, because we fully understand from our own experiences. Our innovative and reliable products are engineered for the nuances of the African landscape, empowering frontline providers to deliver excellent healthcare to patients. Our products include the Provider Digitization Suite—HeliumOS and HeliumDoc, Financial Solutions—HeliumCredit and HeliumWallet, and Our Public Health & Data Partnerships - Public Health and Data and Insights.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Backend Engineer (Elixir)

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Work Mode: Hybrid

Responsibilities


	Support and maintain existing production code in the field and develop and deliver new enhancements and products to our client base. 
	Collaborate with product management, operations, quality assurance, and front-end engineers to deliver the right solution. 
	Develop reliable, high-performance service applications using Elixir - Phoenix.
	Provision, configure, and develop against remote infrastructure in AWS. 


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related discipline with at least 3 years of programming experience with Elixir
	Must have experience defining the scope and directing the work of mid-level - junior software engineers
	Integration of user-facing elements developed by a front-end developer with our API 
	Building reusable code and libraries for future use 
	Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) 
	Optimization of the application for maximum speed and scalability 
	Separation of centralized services into microservices 
	Experience with Git, Jenkins, Docker, Ansible/Chef/Puppet, or similar tools 
	Pride in readable, well-designed, well-tested software. 
	Experience with relational databases (PostGreSQL, MySQL) and key-value stores (Memcache, Redis).
	Proficiency in the use of AI tools to accelerate development, debugging, testing, documentation, and problem-solving.
	Good oral and written communication skills.


Benefits


	Package includes guaranteed take home 
	20 days holidays + public holidays 
	Enhanced Parental + Family Leave – 60 days paid maternity leave and 20 days paid paternity leave, our adoption leave policy follows the similar arrangements. 
	Health lnsurance or medical allowance 
	Robust learning and development opportunities 
	Team-building activities and social events 
	Amazing team culture.

Backend Engineer (Elixir) Job at Helium Health




        
    

        
        Helium Health, is a full-service Healthtech company on a journey to digitize healthcare across Africa. We have been doing this since 2016, and our pioneering approach has helped to transform healthcare delivery systems across Sub-Saharan Africa and the GCC, creating an alternative vision for patients and providers, whilst facilitating hundreds of thousands of high-quality patient experiences every month.
     

            
    



We are very good at creating for the market we live in, because we fully understand from our own experiences. Our innovative and reliable products are engineered for the nuances of the African landscape, empowering frontline providers to deliver excellent healthcare to patients. Our products include the Provider Digitization Suite—HeliumOS and HeliumDoc, Financial Solutions—HeliumCredit and HeliumWallet, and Our Public Health & Data Partnerships - Public Health and Data and Insights.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Backend Engineer (Elixir)

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Work Mode: Hybrid

Responsibilities


	Support and maintain existing production code in the field and develop and deliver new enhancements and products to our client base. 
	Collaborate with product management, operations, quality assurance, and front-end engineers to deliver the right solution. 
	Develop reliable, high-performance service applications using Elixir - Phoenix.
	Provision, configure, and develop against remote infrastructure in AWS. 


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related discipline with at least 3 years of programming experience with Elixir
	Must have experience defining the scope and directing the work of mid-level - junior software engineers
	Integration of user-facing elements developed by a front-end developer with our API 
	Building reusable code and libraries for future use 
	Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) 
	Optimization of the application for maximum speed and scalability 
	Separation of centralized services into microservices 
	Experience with Git, Jenkins, Docker, Ansible/Chef/Puppet, or similar tools 
	Pride in readable, well-designed, well-tested software. 
	Experience with relational databases (PostGreSQL, MySQL) and key-value stores (Memcache, Redis).
	Proficiency in the use of AI tools to accelerate development, debugging, testing, documentation, and problem-solving.
	Good oral and written communication skills.


Benefits


	Package includes guaranteed take home 
	20 days holidays + public holidays 
	Enhanced Parental + Family Leave – 60 days paid maternity leave and 20 days paid paternity leave, our adoption leave policy follows the similar arrangements. 
	Health lnsurance or medical allowance 
	Robust learning and development opportunities 
	Team-building activities and social events 
	Amazing team culture.
